none: PAS SOM-511184: Roman coin: Contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Somerset (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of Constantius II (AD337-361), dating to AD 355-361 (Reece period 18). Imitating the FEL TEMP REPARATIO reverse type, with a crude depiction of a soldier spearing a fallen horseman. The obverse legend appears to conflate Constans and Constantius II's names
